# Claude Harness

> One command installs a tested Claude Code harness: skills, hooks, rules, sub-agents and memory. claude-harness (`claude-harness`) copies a tested `.claude/` setup and a `memory/` folder into any project in three tiers (starter, pro, expert); `init` takes flags so an agent can run it without prompts, `verify` checks the result, and `sandbox-run` tries it inside an E2B microVM first. It ships a CLI, an MCP server (`claude-harness-mcp`, three tools), 18 skills and a Claude Code plugin, and it improves itself through its own golden tasks.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, the two surfaces, every command and MCP tool, the editing rules
- [README.md](README.md): overview, one-step install for every coding agent, quick start

## Skills

- [install-harness](skills/install-harness/SKILL.md): install the harness without prompts, pick the tier, confirm it works
- [debug-harness-hooks](skills/debug-harness-hooks/SKILL.md): find why a hook does not fire, fails, or blocks the wrong thing
- [upgrade-harness](skills/upgrade-harness/SKILL.md): bring an installed harness up to date without losing local edits
- [All 18 skills](docs/SKILLS.md): the general harness skills and these three

## MCP tools

- [MCP server source](mcp-server.mjs): three tools over stdio: list_tiers, scaffold_plan, memory_search
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin, named harness (skills, sub-agents, hook, MCP server)
- [Gemini CLI extension](gemini-extension.json): context and MCP server for Gemini CLI
- [A2A agent card](.well-known/agent-card.json): name, description, skills
